items.name: tt-a1i/archify
items.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
items.comment: 把架构图、时序图、数据流图做成"可验证"的自包含 HTML，带动效与高清导出，是 Agent 自动出架构文档的新玩法；空降即破千星，印证"图即代码"需求。

items.name: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.description: Prompt as Code ｜ GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出 Skills，持续更新中。
items.comment: 连续霸榜的提示词工程黑马，日增由昨日 +1,698 暴力反弹至 +4,044 断层领跑；把 GPT-Image-2 跑出的视觉案例反向蒸馏为可复用模板与 Skill，电商图、品牌物料、短视频封面团队可直接 fork 套用。

items.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
items.comment: Anthropic 官方直管插件目录，强调人工筛选的"高质量"，与 community 镜像互补，是 Claude Code 插件生态的权威来源；昨日新晋后今日继续稳居。

items.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
items.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly).
items.comment: 把 Claude Code / Codex / Pi / OpenCode 的免费额度整合进终端、App、IDE、手机，支持语音，号称 ToS 友好；前日午间曾上榜后回落，今日重新杀回榜单。

items.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.comment: 基于 Claude Code 的本地求职 Agent 框架：评估岗位 → 定制 CV → 写求职信 → 准备面试一条龙，数据全留本机；连续在榜且日增稳定，应届与转码党刚需。

items.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, PKM, and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
items.comment: Obsidian Vault + Claude Code 组合成自组织第二大脑，扔进资料自动归档、链接并构建知识图谱，是 Karpathy "LLM Wiki" 模式最佳开源实践。

items.name: basecamp/omarchy
items.comment: Basecamp 维护的"美观、现代、强观点" Linux 发行版，开箱即用开发者桌面，与 Hyprland 深度集成，适合想摆脱 Ubuntu 默认桌面美学的工程师。

items.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
items.comment: 以"learn → build → ship"三段论组织 AI 工程实战教程，从底层原理到产品级落地，适合作为个人 AI 项目从学习到发布的路线图。

items.name: tinyhumansai/openhuman
items.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
items.comment: 定位"个人 AI 超智"，核心是 local-first 长期记忆 + Agent 集群编排 + 深度研究三件套，强调数据归属用户，是 Obsidian 派系的精神续作。

items.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
items.comment: 用一句"最懒高级工程师"心智模型约束 Agent——能不写代码就不写，主打减少过度实现与幻觉，是近期最出圈的工程哲学型提示词/行为库。

items.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
items.comment: Anthropic 官方运营的 Claude Code / Claude Cowork 社区插件市场镜像，所有 PR 通过提交链接流转，是 Claude 生态扩展的官方入口。

items.name: ConardLi/garden-skills
items.description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
items.comment: 前端大牛 ConardLi 开源的 Skills 合集，覆盖网页设计、知识检索、图像生成等场景，是技能复用层"个人品牌化"的代表。

items.name: browser-use/browser-use
items.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
items.comment: 让网站对 AI Agent 可操作的老牌明星项目，自动化网页任务的底层基座；存量 11 万星巨仓今日重回榜单，说明 Web Agent 叙事持续发热。

items.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 175,000+ scientists worldwide. 163 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery.
items.comment: 把任意 Agent 变成"AI 科学家"，163 个已验证技能 + 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物/化学/医药/药物发现，号称全球 17.5 万科学家在用，是 Skills 垂直化最深的案例之一。

items.name: marin-community/marin
items.description: Open-source framework for the research and development of foundation models.
items.comment: 面向基础模型研发的开源框架，社区化运作（marin-community），覆盖从数据到训练的工程链路，是开源复刻前沿大模型训练流程的新选择。

items.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
items.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
items.comment: 收录 1000+ 官方与社区 Agent Skills 的精选列表，兼容 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor 等多端；前日午间曾上榜后回落，今日再度回归。
